conclusion: The Cantor committed equity facility is optional share-sale capacity, not cash already raised or XRP already purchased. The October 30 prospectus supersedes the earlier $80.7 million illustrative gross estimate with an approximately $76.8 million estimate using a later XRPN share price; both estimates refer to the same 5,218,935-share ceiling.

sources.paraphrase: The prospectus registers up to 5,218,935 new Class A shares for potential sales to Cantor under an October 23 committed equity facility. At the October 29 XRPN close of $14.71, the issuer estimates up to approximately $76.8 million gross if the full share ceiling is sold. The issuer separately discloses a $521,893.50 cash commitment fee. The prospectus distinguishes the issuer's primary sale to Cantor from Cantor's later resale to the public.
limitations: The $76.8 million is a maximum illustrative gross estimate, not a cash receipt.
The facility purchase price is contractually based on 97% of applicable VWAP, subject to other pricing terms; the cover-page calculation is not an executed purchase price.
The commitment fee is a company cash cost, not proceeds.
The filing does not establish that any purchase notice was delivered or settled.

sources.paraphrase: The company may send purchase notices after commencement and satisfaction of conditions; it has the right but not the obligation to sell. Cantor pays cash for shares actually purchased, with settlement due by 5 p.m. New York time on the second trading day after the applicable share-delivery date. The ordinary purchase price is 97% of the applicable VWAP, with a separate lower-price formula for certain large-volume notices. Beneficial ownership is capped at 4.99%, and purchase share amounts are limited by a 20% trading-volume percentage. The $521,893.50 upfront fee is fully earned and non-refundable as of the Closing Date regardless of whether purchases occur; a true-up may apply, with aggregate commitment fees capped at $1 million.

limitations: Contractual capacity and conditions do not prove Commencement occurred.
No purchase notice, share delivery, cash settlement or XRP acquisition is evidenced by this agreement alone.
The fee is an obligation/cost even if no VWAP purchases are made.

price_assumption_reconciliation.interpretation: The two gross figures use the same share ceiling and different XRPN reference prices. They are not two facilities, two cash receipts or two XRP purchases.

actual_capital_ledger.caveat: No public draw or settlement evidence was identified in the reviewed filings through 2026-11-07. This does not prove that no private notice or settlement occurred.

model_admission.permitted_use: Capital-structure/event timeline with separate capacity, gross proceeds, fees, settlements and XRP acquisition fields.
prohibited_inferences: Treating $76.8M or $80.7M as cash already raised.
Treating the commitment fee as proceeds.
Treating a share purchase facility as a debt facility.
Treating equity issuance as proof of XRP purchases.
Treating XRP treasury growth intent as realized acquisition.

Reconcile any issued shares to transfer-agent/SEC ownership records and the company's diluted share count.
Reconcile cash proceeds separately from fees, expenses, debt and prior subscriptions.
Require separate custody/trade evidence before attributing any facility proceeds to XRP acquisitions.
